patch_resolves_note: The staged patch adds `hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped)` to `fixup_pcap_pkthdr()` before any USB mmapped pseudo-header field access. On the stock PoC the fixed original is guarded, and the adjacent `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness executes the same sink-side event with the full-header predicate genuinely satisfied.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project parser statement that reads the remainder of the attacker-controlled pcap global header into `hdr`, materializing the version, snaplen, and linktype state that later drives the vulnerable USB fixup path.

Root cause. The outer USB fixup branch is entered solely on `linktype` and omits the required `hdr->caplen >= sizeof (pcap_usb_header_mmapped)` precondition before the function interprets `data` as a full USB pseudo-header.

ASan crash site. `fixup_pcap_pkthdr()` dereferences `usb_hdr->data_flag` from the packet buffer after casting `data` to `pcap_usb_header_mmapped *`, even though this witness provides only the 4-byte heap buffer allocated from the savefile snapshot length.
Intermediate runtime event packet_data_ready materialized from verified transition assertion A-PACKET-DATA-POINTER-REACHES-USB-SINK.

edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace verifies `packet_data_ready.packet_data_ptr == usb_data_flag_sink.data_ptr`. The same equality also holds in the `full_mmapped_usb_header_64` witness, showing the selected propagation edge is the concrete buffer handoff into the sink rather than an incidental crash-only address.
